title: Release request (plugins/<id>/release.json)
description: The version to publish. The only file a deploy PR may change.

version.description: Semver version, without the `v`. The plugin repository must have the tag `v<version>` or `<version>` pointing to `commit`.

commit.description: Full commit hash the version is built from.

security.description: Published versions marked as vulnerable. Entries are only ever added by a deploy PR; editing or removing one needs human review.
